name: Dr. Cortez
bio:
At Pediatric Dental Specialists in Long Beach, California, Dr. Cortez and the team believe that a healthy smile is a cornerstone of your child's overall well-being. From the very first visit, every detail is designed to put young patients at ease — including a personalized storybook featuring your child's own name, making that first appointment feel like a special adventure rather than something to worry about.

Dr. Cortez leads a qualified, compassionate team dedicated to guiding children toward optimal oral health in a nurturing and friendly environment. Whether it's a routine checkup or a child's very first dental experience, the goal is always the same: to build lasting trust, healthy habits, and confident smiles that grow alongside your child.
